name: Securities Financing Reporting Reconciliation Status Advice V 02
definition: The SecuritesFinancingReportingReconciliationStatusAdvice message is sent by the trade repositories (TRs) ) to other TR and to the authority or made available to the report submitting entity and the reporting counterparty as well as the entity responsible for reporting, if applicable, to provide a status advice for reconciliation.

ReconciliationData.name: Reconciliation Data
ReconciliationData.definition: Set of data concerning the reconciliation results.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
